name: pi-extensions
description: Four pi extensions that compose into a code-mode agent runtime: a Python kernel, a learned-skill store, web host functions, and child-session context management.

scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/rlm test && bun run --cwd packages/web-code test && bun run --cwd packages/rsi test
scripts.check: bun run test && bun run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/rlm typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/web-code typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/rsi typecheck
